title: Slovakian Lard and Tagine Dish
description: A unique keto meal inspired by Slovakian and North African flavors, made with slow-cooked meat and rich lard.

ingredients.name: Dried tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: Traditionally used in North African cuisine

ingredients.name: Caraway seeds
ingredients.notes: Common in Slovakian and Eastern European cooking

instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, and dried tagine spice mix.
Heat the lard in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and slow-cook the pork shoulder for 4-5 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the caraway seeds.
Serve the pork shoulder hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Note: Traditionally, this dish would be cooked in a clay tagine, but a Dutch oven or slow cooker can be used as a substitute.
